newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui and provincial Governor James Soong to meet today (Thursday), may decide fate of Soong's pending resignation.
Lee Teng-hui says Taiwan's constitution must be revised.
LIBERTY TIMES - Vice-President Lien Chan to visit Vatican, may meet Pope.
James Soong cancels meeting with President Lee Teng-hui.
CHINA TIMES - Court official punished for failing to prevent corruption under his supervision.
Police fail to find Chiayi County speaker Hsiao Teng-piao, who is under investigation for involvement in organised crime.

COMMERCIAL TIMES - Securities Exchange Commission to guard against negative impact on Taiwan stock index futures being launched by CME and SIMEX, but share prices break 7,000-point resistance in celebration rally on eve of their launch.
Taiwan, China to hold talks on direct shipping links next month.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government to release state shares of Big Three commercial banks at appropriate time.
Taiwan stock market faces uncertain future as offshore Taiwan stock index futures being launched in Singapore and Chicago.
